part.text:
Fixed. The issue was in `formatter<tuple_join_view<Char, T...>, Char>` in include/fmt/ranges.h:628 — its `parse` ignored format specifiers entirely.

Changes:
- Added a member `std::tuple<formatter<typename std::decay<T>::type, Char>...> formatters_` holding one formatter per tuple element.
- `parse` now delegates to each element formatter via recursive `do_parse`, throwing `format_error("incompatible format specs for tuple elements")` if element types disagree on how much of the spec they consume.
- `format_args` now formats each element with its stored (spec-parsed) formatter instead of a fresh default one.

Verified: the repro now prints `01, 02, 03` for both vector and tuple, and all 18 test suites pass (`ranges-test`, `format-test`, `xchar-test`, etc.), covering the new spec cases like `{:+03}` on `std::tuple<int, int, long>`.
